t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It seems to be related to colour choices, matching gnome to basket, but also a random element

vb_textbox.text: It is very difficult to work out the pattern due to the speed with which you have to respond. I think it is something to do with the colours of the gnomes and the shape of their caps, but even the exact  same combinations produced different mushrooms results so there seems to be a random element as well. I had pretty good success mostly choosing the brown and pink gnomes when available. Yellow often gave 0 mushrooms.
